reuse.why: The tree has no shared link function, so the change adds one guard helper and calls it from every provider's link function rather than inlining the check five times.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the five guard calls repeat, each restating the provider literal that the same function also writes as account_sync_source.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts with the link functions and runs first, before any bank, account or sync side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, single definition of 'already linked'; a future provider must remember to call it, and the provider string is passed separately from the one stored, which could drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; all five *-accounts-link handlers call the new guard.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond one-line calls to the shared guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
